ideas.title: Investigating Medicaid Funding Fraud in Minnesota
ideas.description: This story would investigate potential fraud in Medicaid funding in Minnesota, including the recent investigation into a Somali-owned transportation company.
questions: What is the extent of Medicaid funding fraud in Minnesota?
How much money has been lost to fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover significant fraud and corruption in the Medicaid funding system. By following the money and investigating the contracts and payments, we may be able to identify the perpetrators and bring them to justice.
